articles.title: Ilia Topuria: "Lo que me mantiene motivado para 2027 es recuperar mi cinturón"
articles.standfirst: 'El Matador' está decidido a volver por todo lo alto tras su traspiés en el UFC Casa Blanca
articles.summary: 'El Matador' está decidido a volver por todo lo alto tras su traspiés en el UFC Casa Blanca
articles.body: Ilia Topuria ha dejado un legado imborrable en el mundo de las MMA y más concretamente en la UFC. En poco tiempo el peleador hispano georgiano se ha convertido en el primer doble campeón invicto de la historia de la compañía y ha dejado actuaciones para el recuerdo como los tres K.O. consecutivos a Alexander Volkanovski, Max Holloway y Charles Oliveira. Sin embargo, el pasado 14 de junio perdió el invicto y el cinturón de peso ligero en el UFC Casa Blanca ante Justin Gaethje, y ha afirmado que lo que le motiva a seguir es volver en 2027 pasa recuperarlo. Hace cinco meses, Ilia Topuria perdió su invicto y su corona en una noche fatídica en la que no le salieron las cosas, justo al contrario que a Gaethje. El peleador estadounidense realizó la estrategia perfecta y obligó a Aleksandre Topuria a parar la pelea antes de dar comienzo el quinto asalto, generando una espina se mantiene clavada en Ilia desde entonces. De hecho, una vez volvió a aparecer en el ojo público el pasado septiembre no ha parado de decir que su objetivo principal es una revancha inmediata con Gaethje, y en una entrevista con 'JD Sports' ha explicado su objetivo principal para 2027. "Lo que me mantiene motivado de cara a 2027 es recuperar mi cinturón. Quiero conseguir la revancha y volver a ser campeón", sentenció. Topuria tendrá el alta para volver a entrenar a alta intensidad y hacer sparrings a partir de enero, fecha en la que también se espera que se conozca más acerca de cuándo y contra quién peleará en su siguiente aparición. A pesar de sus intenciones, Gaethje no parece muy por la labor de darle una revancha, y la realidad es que un supercombate contra Paddy Pimblett está más cerca que nunca. De hecho, incluso 'El Matador' parece haberse cansado de llamar a la puerta de Gaethje, y a principios de semana puso un tuit donde retaba a Pimblett a realizar juntos 'The Ultimate Fighter' para luego medirse en el octágono. En caso de ganar a 'The Baddy', su archienemigo deportivo, tendría vía libre para volver a obtener una oportunidad titular y recuperar el oro. Topuria dijo hace unas semanas que pronto tendría reuniones con la UFC para negociar su siguiente pelea, así que todo debería esclarecerse pronto. Paddy Pimblett, Justin Gaethje o incluso Arman Tsarukyan por el cinturón vacante si Justin se retira son las opciones más viables, y todas ellas serían peleas muy mediáticas que en caso de ganar relanzarían la carrera de Ilia.

articles.title: Daniel Dubois to fight Joseph Parker in WBO heavyweight world championship clash in Manchester on January 30
articles.summary: Daniel Dubois will box former world champion Joseph Parker on January 30 at Manchester's Co-op Live arena; Dubois will be defending the WBO heavyweight world title he secured defeating Fabio Wardley; Parker has had his suspension lifted
articles.body:
Dubois and Parker were due to box in 2025 for the IBF title, only for Dubois to fall ill and withdraw just three days before the fight.

Parker knocked out short-notice replacement Martin Bakole and then lost a WBO Interim title bout to Fabio Wardley.

In August he announced that he could continue his career after a suspension was lifted following a failed drug test in October 2025.

Dubois lost the IBF strap to Oleksandr Usyk last year but stormed back to form when he twice halted Wardley, winning and retaining the full WBO world championship .

He will now be back in action early in the new year against Parker, who's also recorded standout wins over Deontay Wilder and Zhilei Zhang in recent years.

A former holder of the belt, the New Zealander lost the WBO championship to Anthony Joshua back in 2018 at the Principality Stadium when he became the first professional opponent to go the distance with Joshua.

Frank Warren said: "This heavyweight showdown will deliver a blockbuster beginning to 2027.

"It's a fight everyone wanted to see, and I'm thrilled we can now make it happen. Daniel is entering his prime and when he is on his game it is hard to picture anybody beating him.

"But Joseph has long promised to become world champion again, and now he gets his chance. "

articles.title: Daniel Dubois to defend heavyweight title against ex-Anthony Joshua rival in Manchester
articles.summary: Daniel Dubois has beaten domestic rival Fabio Wardley twice in 2026 and now has his next opponent lined up
articles.body:
Daniel Dubois will put his WBO heavyweight title on the line against former champion Joseph Parker at Manchester's Co-op Live Arena on 30 January.

The pair were previously scheduled to fight for the IBF belt in 2025, but the contest was called off days before when Dubois fell ill.

Dubois claimed the WBO belt by beating domestic rival Fabio Wardley at the venue in May, before repeating the win inside two rounds in a London rematch in October.

Parker previously held the WBO crown between 2016 and 2018 before losing to Anthony Joshua in a unification fight, and he has not boxed since an interim title loss to Wardley in October 2025.

Promoter Frank Warren said: "Daniel is in his prime and when he is on his game it is hard to picture anybody beating him.

"But Joseph has long promised to become world champion again, and now he gets his chance."

Parker has not fought in 2026 after he tested positive for cocaine shortly before his defeat by Wardley, although the result of the test was only made public after the stoppage loss.

The New Zealander maintained his innocence following the positive test and was cleared to fight in August following an investigation.

"I'm pleased to confirm my provisional suspension is lifted, and I'll be back in the ring soon," Parker said in August, per the BBC.

"I've been advised to say no more for now while details are finalised. Thank you to all my supporters."

Parker has a professional record of 36-4 (24 KOs). His other defeats came against British duo Dillian Whyte and Joe Joyce. However, he does hold impressive wins over Deontay Wilder, Derek Chisora and Martin Bakole.

Wilder and Bakole are due to fight each other on the undercard of Joshua's highly-anticipated clash with Tyson Fury in Cardiff next month.
